assertions.assert: Each element (observe, escalate) takes exactly its declared attributes, the required ones present and none empty, and no content, and the namespace has no other element: a malformed element raises error.execution and assigns nothing (its schema, package/intuition.xsd, rejects it before any run under scx validate).

<intuition:observe> keeps the original's ConfidenceTuner state {mean, var, n}: anything else is read as the initial state {mean: 70, var: 100, n: 0}; a number confidence, clamped to 0-100, is observed (the first sets the mean, later ones move the mean and variance by the EMA with alpha 0.08, the variance never under 100), and a null confidence is not.

<intuition:escalate> writes true exactly when the confidence is a number below the tuner's threshold: the floor 35 during the warmup of 8 observations, else max(17.5, mean - sqrt(max(var, 100))); a null confidence never escalates.
A confidence that is neither a number nor null raises error.execution and assigns nothing.
